title: Share HTTP write delegation and token validation
goal: Vision: V-6. Reduce repeated AsyncWrite/Hyper Write forwarding and RFC token validation while preserving public APIs, byte acceptance, pin projection, dispatch and every test.

reuse.searched: Current std server, Hyper builder and locked Hyper1.12 parser; existing TokioIo and PrefixedIo write delegation; existing HTTP1/HTTP2, TLS, chunking and shutdown tests. No external source needed. Server and wire token validators accept the same ASCII alphabet and reject empty tokens.
reuse.reason: Three five-method implementations forward identically to inner AsyncWrite. A private macro retains the same implementation instead of copying it. Broader server replacement is unproven: HTTP1-only/no-timeout and blocking native TLS contracts differ, and Hyper rejects LF-only/leading-whitespace chunk sizes accepted by the current server.

constraints: No dependency, protocol, feature, public API or test changes.
No source exclusions, test relocation or minification.
Private worktree, target, runtime home and compiler; jobs2. Parent integrates and publishes; no external messages or pushes.

evidence.validation: 48existing package tests passed, focused all-targets strictClippy/fmt/diff passed;1,194,242 old/new token comparisons matched; all15write methods source-identical ignoring indentation; independent review no findings.

integration_result: 72 runtime lines removed;48existing package tests,1194242tokencomparisons,methodbody/testtail parity,strictClippy,fmt/socket/task checks passed on integratedLinuxdevelopment tree. Source and evidence remoteverified. Complete307737-line goal remains open.
